title: The New Jim Crow
author: Michelle Alexander
summary: Michelle Alexander, a civil rights lawyer, argues that mass incarceration in the United States works as a new system of racial control after Jim Crow. She focuses on the war on drugs and what a criminal record takes away.
readIf: you want a rigorous, forceful argument about race and the American justice system.
skipIf: you want a quick, neutral summary of criminal justice policy.
